name: evaluate the message as a polynomial at a secret point, then add a one-time mask
mechanism: split the message into blocks and treat them as coefficients of a polynomial; evaluate it at a secret point modulo a prime by running multiply-and-add over the blocks; add a one-time secret value so the evaluation point is never exposed; two messages agreeing at the point is a low-probability event bounded by the degree

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Poly1305' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

requires: a fresh one-time mask per message
fails_when: reusing the mask reveals the secret point
